# Calculate dimensions and positions for the angular plate
edge_length = 140  # mm
thickness = 10  # mm
cutout_size = 45  # mm

# First plate (horizontal) - lies in XY plane
plate1_x = edge_length
plate1_y = edge_length
plate1_z = thickness
plate1_x_pos = 0
plate1_y_pos = 0
plate1_z_pos = 0

# Second plate (vertical) - stands perpendicular to first plate along one edge
# It will be positioned at the edge of the first plate
plate2_x = thickness  # thickness in X direction
plate2_y = edge_length  # same edge length
plate2_z = edge_length  # height equals edge length
plate2_x_pos = edge_length - thickness  # positioned at the edge of first plate
plate2_y_pos = 0
plate2_z_pos = 0

# Cutout position (centered on the first plate)
cutout_x = cutout_size
cutout_y = cutout_size
cutout_z = thickness  # same thickness to cut through
cutout_x_pos = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_y_pos = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_z_pos = 0

print("First plate (horizontal):")

print("\nSecond plate (vertical):")
print(f"  Dimensions: {plate2_x} x {plate2_y} x {plate2_z} mm")
print(f"  Position: ({plate2_x_pos}, {plate2_y_pos}, {plate2_z_pos})")
print("\nCutout:")

print(f"  Position: ({cutout_x_pos}, {cutout_y_pos}, {cutout_z_pos})")
